measure: 38 macroeconomic labour demographic education health governance digital and investment indicators
period: 1950-present where available; request range defaults to 2010-present
unit: current source-declared indicator unit where returned; preserve code and label
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Indicator coverage and units differ; latest observation years are indicator-specific; do not equate retrieval date with observation date. New indicators remain outside EOM score until validated.

dataset: Annual total immigration and emigration API
measure: Total annual immigration or emigration; filtered to annual frequency, persons, total age and total sex
geography: All reporting geographies returned by Eurostat
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Contains national and regional/aggregate geographies; keep immigration/emigration and definitions distinct from birth citizenship and previous-residence subgroups.

measure: International migrant stock resident in destination, by sex
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Stock not flow; country of birth used as main basis and citizenship where needed; reference years only, no interpolation.

measure: Emigrant stock by country/area of origin and sex
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Origin stock is not an annual outbound flow and may include refugees/other populations under the source definitions.

measure: Bilateral origin-to-destination migrant stock by sex
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Do not interpolate missing bilateral pairs; reported zero and unreported pair are different. Regional aggregates are excluded from country pairs.

dataset: Official population statistics on forcibly displaced and stateless people
measure: Displacement and statelessness populations by population type, origin, location and time
period: 1952-present; exact period by population type and series
geography: Global source filtered to focus destinations and selected origin countries
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Population types are not interchangeable; refugees, asylum-seekers, IDPs and stateless persons must be kept distinct and not interpreted as voluntary/economic migration.

dataset: International Migration Database SDMX bounded series selector
measure: Raw selected annual OECD dimension slice; retain codes and labels
interpretation_and_quality_notes: B11 is preserved as a source code and not semantically remapped until its dimension definition is reviewed; OECD national definitions are not always fully comparable.

measure: Official catalogue and downloadable asset discovery only
interpretation_and_quality_notes: As of this PR, numeric tables in linked PDFs/spreadsheets are not yet parsed; no numeric OBMigra observations are claimed.

dataset: International Labour Migration Statistics selected official series
measure: Working-age foreign-born stock; employed foreign-born stock; inflow of working-age foreign-born by sex and country of birth
unit: Source units declared in indicator label (thousands for configured series)
interpretation_and_quality_notes: Source codes, country-of-birth classifications, source labels and observation flags are retained. Coverage is sparse and survey/source definitions differ; not a fully comparable bilateral flow panel.
